state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 8, the feature proofs, is in progress.** Stages 1 to 7 are on disk: every export of `nvs:intl/icu` works, both components are embedded, and the growth test and the bundle test pass.

Every `Novis\Intl` job class owes nothing: `Collator`, `NumberFormat`, `PluralRules`, `DateFormat`, `RelativeTime`, `ListFormat`, `Segmenter` and `Locale`. The manifest class `Novis\Intl\Icu` owes nothing too: each member has an about page, a Rust `covers:` marker beside its job member's, and a plain call in `tests/conformance/novis/intl-icu-exports-answer-when-called-directly.nvst`. Its examples, attack and bench are skip entries in `data/proofs/policy.json` that name the job member wrapping each export one-to-one. `bun nv proofs --verify --group '<Class>'` passes for all nine.

Still red: `bun nv proofs --gate` over the whole roster, 210 features. `Novis\Intl` is 14 of them: the enums `Strength`, `CaseFirst`, `NumberStyle`, `CurrencyDisplay`, `CompactDisplay`, `PluralKind`, `PluralCategory`, `Length`, `ZoneStyle`, `TimeUnit`, `Width`, `Numeric`, `ListType` and `Service`, each owing about, examples and tests. The rest is outside this goal's scope: 182 stale perf figures (`Core\BigInt`, `Core\Uri`, `Core\Time*`, `Core\Http*`, `Core\Crypto*`, `Core\Random*`, `Core\Uuid`), `Novis\Image` members and `Output`, `ExtensionError`, `Core\DeprecatedError` and three directives. `bun nv proofs --owed --limit 0` lists them.

`--record-perf` refuses with "the calibration did not measure anything" when the machine is busy; running it again a minute later worked. A `Novis\Intl` call costs 0.3 to 0.7 ms in its bench.

next.title: the feature proofs, the `Novis\Intl` enums
next.note: one file set: the enum rows of `extensions/intl/manifest.json` and the `Intl-<Enum>` directories under `docs/examples/novis/`. The path an enum's proofs live at is not checked: `bun nv proofs --group` does not take an enum, so read it from `bun nv proofs --json`.

items.text: **The 14 `Novis\Intl` enums owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): an about page, three examples and a test from each side per enum. An enum is not attacked or benched. The enums are declared at `extensions/intl/manifest.json:137` (`Strength`) through `extensions/intl/manifest.json:150` (`Service`). Existing `.nvst` cases under `tests/conformance/novis/` use most of them, so a `covers:` line may be the whole test edit.

**The whole roster owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): decide what of the other 196 owed features this goal must close, because the check `dossier-the-whole-roster-owes-nothing-with-novis-intl` runs `bun nv proofs --gate` over everything. The 182 stale perf figures are re-measured with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<Class>'`, starting with `Core\BigInt` from `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/bigint.rs:1`. The `Novis\Image` and directive features have owner goals that are not checked yet.

backlog: `Novis\Intl` calls cost 0.3 to 0.7 ms each in their benches (`docs/perf/members.ndjson`). Whether instantiation or the formatter's construction dominates is not checked; `rule:packaging/the-boundary-is-the-cost` owns the figure.
